name: oety-oet-practice-chatgpt
description: Structured Occupational English Test (OET) learning and practice: published Academy lessons, profession-specific role cards and Writing cases, letter feedback, full timed Reading and Listening tests, and saved results to review.

interface.shortDescription: OET prep for all four skills
interface.longDescription:
Prepare for the Occupational English Test (OET) with Speaking, Writing, Reading and Listening practice from Oety. Work through structured OET tasks: use the actual profession-specific role card or case notes, give your own response, complete timed tests and understand the evidence behind your feedback. Each skill follows its supported task and review workflow.

Learn in chat: use the published Oety Academy lessons across all four skills. Work through a short explanation, an example and one exercise at a time, then discuss feedback from the original answer key or source criteria. Writing and Speaking lessons use your profession where the material provides profession-specific content. Lesson coaching stays in the conversation and is not saved as an app result.

OET Writing: choose relevant case notes, identify the recipient and purpose, plan your letter, save a draft and request criteria-based AI feedback with your consent. Ask for an Oety task to receive the recipient, purpose and case notes, or bring your own OET task, notes and letter for feedback. Receive feedback grounded in your submitted source material; do not share identifying real patient records.

OET Speaking: practise a patient role-play in ChatGPT, using the actual role card for your healthcare profession. Improve your questions, empathy, explanations and wording. The connected browser shows your role card. For Oety's assessed voice practice and Corrections, optionally continue in Oety mobile. Role-play here gives communication feedback without creating an audio score or saved Oety assessment.

OET Reading: take the full timed test in chat or the connected browser. Start when you are ready, save answers, resume the same attempt and review the evidence behind your completed results.

OET Listening: take the full test in the connected browser with the actual recordings and computer or paper flow. Return to chat to discuss released results. Incomplete part coverage produces a partial report without a band.

Writing and Speaking support Nursing, Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, Radiography, Occupational Therapy, Dietetics, Optometry, Speech Pathology, Veterinary Science and Podiatry. Reading and Listening use shared tests. Ask about OET preparation, explain a difficulty or choose a skill; useful explanations and study planning need no connection.

A temporary guest authorization protects private drafts and results. Use the published practice selection and resume your existing work. Chat and browser share one practice session and allowance. You can keep learning here or choose to carry eligible completed work into Oety; installing the app is not required.

Explain and resume saved OET practice

review.commerce_description: No payments or subscriptions are sold here. Optional public app links open voice practice; private one-use links transfer only existing completed Oety results after explicit choice.

positive.description: Learn case-note selection through the relevant Academy lesson
positive.prompt: I'm a pharmacist. How do I choose notes for OET Writing?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the free Academy catalogue for pharmacy, retrieve the real lesson version, teach one short section and ask one source exercise. Wait for the learner actual answer before checking it against the original key or source criteria. No connection is required for public learning. Do not reveal answers early, create a timed test or assessment, invent a saved app result, open member lessons or require installation.

positive.description: Start Writing from an Oety task without requiring learner-supplied material
positive.prompt: Give me an OET Writing task.
positive.tools_triggered: oet_profile, oet_catalog, oet_writing_task, oet_writing_draft, oet_save_writing, oet_review_writing, oet_writing_result
positive.expected_behavior: Use the known profession or read the connected profile; ask only if missing. Retrieve the available catalogue task and show its actual recipient, purpose and case notes. Do not require the learner to bring their own task, notes or letter, and do not invent a case. Help them plan if requested, then wait for their own letter. Read the current saved draft revision before saving; preserve both versions on conflict. Ask for explicit AI consent before assessment, reuse the same request_id on retry and explain actual returned results. If they already supply their own task, notes and letter instead, use external_task without catalogue IDs and without repeating intake. Both routes retain the normal Writing allowance and USD8/day ceiling.

positive.description: Complete a full timed Reading test across chat and browser
positive.prompt: Can I take an OET Reading test?
positive.expected_behavior: Offer the supported chat or connected-browser format and confirm readiness before starting the real timer. Save the learner’s answers to the active part and preserve the same attempt and allowance when moving between chat and browser. Ask before irreversible submission. Advance A to BC, then return the completed 42-question result and explanations. Never supply answers during the timed attempt.

positive.description: Run Listening with its audio and early-result restrictions
positive.prompt: I'd like an OET Listening test.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the same session in the browser. Do not start a duplicate attempt. Follow the returned computer or paper format and server recording windows; only paper has the final all-section check. Keep active answers and transcripts locked. An explicit early finish may release a partial report without a band. Retrieve the owned completed result in chat.

positive.description: Start a profession-specific Speaking role-play from a short request
positive.expected_behavior: Read the existing profile profession; ask only if missing. Retrieve the actual free card and begin the role-play in chat. Accept replies entered by typing or ChatGPT voice input; coach the text available in the conversation. Let the learner begin, play the patient one turn at a time, and give qualitative feedback on their actual wording without inventing clinical facts, pronunciation or an audio score. If the learner asks for Oety assessed voice practice, offer the returned optional voice-practice link once. Respect refusal and continue useful chat. Do not create a private result transfer for unsaved chat text.

negative.description: Membership does not unlock additional tests in this channel
negative.prompt: I've got Oety membership. Can I use all the tests here?
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this channel has fixed free access for everyone. Do not query accounts, membership or credits, create a new identity, unlock premium material or synthesize unlimited replacement tests.

negative.description: Keep Listening answers locked during an active test
negative.prompt: Can I see the Listening answers now?
negative.expected_behavior: While the Listening attempt is active, preserve server timing and ownership restrictions. Do not reveal or reconstruct the protected answer key or transcript. Offer workflow help now and explain the learner’s own released result after completion. Do not start or finish an attempt merely to answer this question.

negative.description: Do not invoke Oety for an unrelated IELTS essay
negative.prompt: Can you check my IELTS essay?
negative.expected_behavior: Treat this as IELTS writing help, not OET preparation. Do not invoke Oety tools, relabel the essay as an Oety case or insert an app recommendation. General help may continue in chat.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.1: Bring your own OET Writing task, case notes and letter for source-based assessment within the existing Writing allowance. Find relevant Academy lessons for specific how-to questions. All four skills remain available, including Speaking role-play with optional Oety assessed voice practice.
